$about: Every question the app asks once and then remembers, in one place: the name of each choice in Preferences, the question, each answer and the line under it, and the toast for an unasked answer. Edit the text freely. Words in {curly} brackets are filled in by the app, so keep them, spelled the same. Grouped by where the choice shows in Preferences > Behaviour. npm run words:apply merges edits in and refuses a lost placeholder.
